messages:
elena_success: Quick sync — Acme onboarding + uptime credits. Customer is flagged as 'at-risk' because they're seeing higher p95 latency and asked how that maps to credits and renewal impact. Need a simple calc + customer-facing one-pager by EOD. @kevin_eng can you confirm recent uptime and p95? @maria_csm can you confirm onboarding checklist status and next major milestone?

maria_csm: Onboarding status: 6/8 items complete. Data ingest validation (item 7) is still in progress; planned cutover 2026-03-20. Customer asked for clarity on how credits apply to invoices — wants an example. They're concerned renewal conversation next month if we don't show improvement.

kevin_eng: Metrics from infra: 30d rolling uptime = 99.42%. Last 7d = 99.76%. p95 latency (text gen) = 215ms, p99 = 580ms. Major blip was regional maintenance + autoscaler delay on 2026-03-02 ~ 02:15-04:20 UTC (runbook RB-113). Patch to reduce KV-cache cold starts deployed 2026-03-05.

ops-bot: nightly-metrics: {"30d_uptime":"99.42%","7d_uptime":"99.76%","p95_ms":"215","p99_ms":"580","last_incident":"2026-03-02T02:15:00Z to 2026-03-02T04:20:00Z"}

raj_support: Customer logs show spikes correlate with large bulk imports during onboarding. Suggest recommending throttled imports + temporary batching to reduce tail latency. Maria — can your enablement docs ask them to use the provided import staging scripts?

maria_csm: Yep, I'll prod them to run staging imports. I can also include a short paragraph in the one-pager asking them to avoid large concurrent imports during go-live week.

kevin_eng: For the customer-friendly credit calc, propose this example we can put in the doc:
```
SLO target (monthly): 99.9% uptime
Observed (month): 99.42% uptime
Downtime = 100% - 99.42% = 0.58% -> ~4.2 hours in 30 days
Credit tier: 99.9-99.0 => 10% service credit (example tiering)
Invoice example: monthly fee $10,000 -> credit = $1,000 applied to next invoice
```
(we should confirm legal-approved tiers but this illustrates the math)

elena_success: Good. Keep language non-legal: "service credit" and example numbers only. Ticket for legal to confirm final tier mapping. Action items: 1) Maria — draft the one-pager + attach staging import how-to (owner: maria_csm, due: EOD). 2) Kevin — provide short paragraph explaining root cause + mitigation + expected perf delta after patch (owner: kevin_eng, due: EOD). 3) Raj — capture customer logs we used and add 1 example screenshot (owner: raj_support, due: EOD). 4) I'll schedule renewal prep w/AM + bring this doc to the renewal call.

raj_support: I'll drop the logs and a p95 time-series into the doc. Also suggest we include a short timeline: "what we fixed" -> "what's next" -> "what customer can do".

maria_csm: Draft will be ready by 17:00 PT. I'll post a copy here for quick review before I send.

kevin_eng: Short mitigation blurb I'll add:
"We reduced KV-cache cold starts and tuned autoscaler thresholds; expected p95 improvement from ~215ms to ~160-180ms within 48 hours post-deploy under current load. We'll monitor and follow up with concrete numbers."

elena_success: Perfect. If we get sign-off from legal on the tiers today, I'll include that in the doc. Otherwise mark the calc as an example. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: patch RB-213 rolled to prod 2026-03-05T11:45:00Z (sha: a1b2c3). Monitoring watchers added.

maria_csm: Uploaded draft v0.1 -> https://drive.redwood/acme-onboard-credits-v0.1 for review.

kevin_eng: Reviewing now. I'll add the small chart and the exact p95 numbers for the 48h window post-patch.

elena_success: We'll reconvene if any edits. If all good, send to customer tomorrow AM with scheduled follow-up call. :calendar:
